_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Hässleholm C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). Three island platforms (tracks 1–2/3, 4/5–6, 7–8) under one footbridge (OSM bridge layer 1, from paths_by_layer) between Magasinsgatan and the station building. Tracks 2/3 and 4/5 are the two ends of one platform face each, and 1, 6, 7 and 8 have a/b sectors in OSM: each face is one platform here (platform_refs), with its node in the middle, as Trafikverket's base track numbers need. OSM's platform piece east of track 1 (way 415061503, along bus stops A–E) is left out: the terminal map draws that strip as the bus terminal and Wikipedia gives 3 platforms; with it, the draft joined it across track 1 to the island. The footways 423426538 and 419690691 are dropped for the same reason (the draft snapped their dead ends across track 1). The 5 lifts are on Skånetrafiken's terminal map (December 2025) and missing in OSM.

connections.note: Lift at the footbridge's west end (Magasinsgatan): on Skånetrafiken's terminal map of Hässleholm C (updated December 2025), missing in OSM; joined to the footway under the bridge (OSM 423426536). Time estimated.
Lift from the tracks 7–8 island up to the footbridge: on Skånetrafiken's terminal map of Hässleholm C (updated December 2025), missing in OSM; placed beside the island's stairs, time estimated.
Lift from the tracks 4/5–6 island up to the footbridge: on Skånetrafiken's terminal map of Hässleholm C (updated December 2025), missing in OSM; placed beside the island's stairs, time estimated.
Lift from the tracks 1–2/3 island up to the footbridge: on Skånetrafiken's terminal map of Hässleholm C (updated December 2025), missing in OSM; placed beside the island's stairs, time estimated.
Lift between the footbridge and the station building's ground floor (main entrance): on Skånetrafiken's terminal map of Hässleholm C (updated December 2025), missing in OSM. Time estimated.

sources.note: Skånetrafiken's terminal map of Hässleholm C (updated December 2025) (PDF 93070_hassleholmc_terminalkarta_a3, supplied by the owner): track numbers, the footbridge's stairs and 5 lifts, 2 ticket machines. Placed by fitting its stair symbols to the tops of OSM's stairs (median 1.7 m off). Not ODbL: ask Skånetrafiken before publishing beyond the demo; see data/stations/README.md.
Jernhusen: Espresso House and Pressbyrån with hours, toilet and accessible toilet (card payment), code lockers (not placed: no source gives where), station open 03.50–02.45. Facts checked by hand.
Trafikverket, 7 April 2026: parts of the platform at track 1 are being demolished for a new switch, so platform 1's ends in OSM (2023) may be out of date.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (extract of 2026-10-20): sector pieces joined into one platform per face; 5 lifts from Skånetrafiken's terminal map (December 2025); the strip east of track 1 and two footways left out (see _comment). Amenities checked against Jernhusen (2026-10-22): Espresso House and Pressbyrån hours updated; 2 ticket machines from the terminal map.
